sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Sunder Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
41 of 2021 at Police Station- Rabupura, District- Gautam Budh Nagar under Sections 498A, 304B,
201 IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 24.02.2021.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 05.06.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Sunder Singh, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. The delay in lodgment of the FIR in the facts and circumstances of the case is fatal to the prosecution case.

Dharmendra vs State Of U.P. on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192470275/
1
2. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
The applicant has harmonious relations with his wife.
3. The applicant never harassed the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
4. The applicant is bereaved by the death of his wife.
5. The victim died of corona virus.
6. The applicant had informed his in laws about the death prior to the cremation.
7. The FIR was lodged in the instigation of third parties to extort money from the applicant.
8. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
9. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Dharmendra be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 19.7.2023 Pravin  Dharmendra vs State Of U.P. on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192470275/
